significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish an ordered causal mechanism: a compact set of heads writes an "uncertainty/keep-checking" signal, later reflection-token positions read it, and that read reactivates the writers; this is a form-(ii) causal claim strengthened by fixing the order of two recurring computations, not merely showing that an uncertainty direction exists. It establishes both the overthinking phenomenon and its mechanism, constraining future observations by predicting that writer activity precedes reflection markers and that selectively cutting the read path terminates recurrence—an informative account given that s1 (Muennighoff et al., 2025) controls reasoning length through coarse budget forcing rather than an internal explanation. Verified false would distinguish a distributed or non-recurrent account from the proposed compact feedback circuit, and the true and false states are determinate despite some ambiguity in the exact marker set. In the topic-substitution check, generic efficient-reasoning interpretability would merit only the median score; the specific write-read-reactivate ordering is what supports an above-median score.

reach.justification: The named handle is a decoding-time intervention that "zeroes or down-weights the loop-driver heads' contribution" specifically at reflection-token query positions, giving auditors or deployment engineers a concrete efficiency control rather than only an explanation. It is ex ante at the level that matters: top-k reflection-marker evidence triggers the edit before the marker is emitted and before the ensuing verification loop consumes additional tokens, leaving an action window during generation. Per-model localization may recover usable heads, but the claim supplies no cross-model quantitative relation predicting which heads or intervention strength will be found; its asserted scope nevertheless covers multiple reasoning tasks and model families, with plausible uptake by practitioners optimizing latency and token cost. The topic alone would not supply this targeted online control, so the topic-substitution check supports an above-median score, but lack of a transferable law keeps it below the highest reach bands.
